records.question: What share of revenue comes from customers who ordered more than once?
records.raw:
WITH order_rev AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id, SUM(op.payment_value) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id
),
cust_order_count AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS num_orders
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN coc.num_orders > 1 THEN orv.revenue ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(orv.revenue) AS share_revenue_repeat_customers
FROM order_rev orv
JOIN cust_order_count coc ON orv.customer_unique_id = coc.customer_unique_id;

records.question: What was the month-on-month revenue growth rate through 2017?
records.raw:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY 1
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    revenue,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
  month,
  revenue,
  prev_revenue,
  ROUND((revenue - prev_revenue) / NULLIF(prev_revenue, 0) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate_pct
FROM with_prev
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month) = 2017
ORDER BY month;

WITH last_complete_month AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', MAX(order_purchase_timestamp)) - INTERVAL '1 month' AS month_start
  FROM orders
)
SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= (SELECT month_start FROM last_complete_month)
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < (SELECT month_start + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM last_complete_month);
